scripts.render:zh: pnpm assets && remotion render src/index.ts LynxPromoZh out/lynx-promo-zh-1080p.mp4 --codec=h264 --pixel-format=yuv420p --audio-codec=aac --audio-bitrate=192k && tsx scripts/normalize-video.ts zh
scripts.render:en: pnpm assets && remotion render src/index.ts LynxPromoEn out/lynx-promo-en-1080p.mp4 --codec=h264 --pixel-format=yuv420p --audio-codec=aac --audio-bitrate=192k && tsx scripts/normalize-video.ts en
scripts.render:cover:zh: pnpm assets && remotion still src/index.ts LynxPromoCoverZh out/lynx-promo-cover-1920x1080.png
scripts.render:cover:en: pnpm assets && remotion still src/index.ts LynxPromoCoverEn out/lynx-promo-cover-en-1920x1080.png
scripts.verify: pnpm test && pnpm typecheck && tsx scripts/verify-media.ts
